entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: "The prosecution story in short is that One Dr. Sweta Deo was married to Dr. Nikhil Kumar on 10.03.2016 at Patna.

At the time of marriage the father of the Dr. Sweta Deo gave Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.35998 of 2021(4) dt.20-04-2023 sufficient gift to the bridegroom but despite all this her husband asked to demand Rs. 20 lacs from her father by which he can open his own clinic at Patna but Dr. Sweta Deo replied that her father has already taken loan for her marriage and she will not ask him to give any money.
After hearing this, the husband and the in-laws of Dr. Sweta Deo became angry and tortured her that if she will not do so then he will leave her and will again marry another girl."

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioner No. 1 (Indu Devi) is the Chacheri Mother-In-Law, petitioner No. 02 (Manish Kumar) is the Chachera Father-In- Law, petitioner No.
03 (Himanshu Kumar) and petitioner No. 04 (Rahul Kumar) are the Chachera Dewar, petitioner No. 05 (Nitesh Kumar) and petitioner No. 06 (Saurabh Kumar) are the Dewar and petitioner No. 07 (Suman Kumari) is the Gotni and there are general and omnibus allegations against all the petitioners.
The petitioners has also relied upon the judgment of Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Kahkashan Kausar and Ors Vs State of Bihar and Ors reported in AIR 2022 SC 820.
The learned APP has submitted that the petitioners may also be directed to raise all the grievances in the Court Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.35998 of 2021(4) dt.20-04-2023 below at the time of framing of charge.

entities.text: Ors Vs State of Bihar and Ors reported in AIR 2022 SC 820
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: I have considered the submissions of the parties.
So far as the allegations against the petitioners are concerned, they are general and omnibus.
So far as the objection of learned APP for the State that the petitioners may be directed to raise all the points at the time of framing of charge.

This objection is also fit to be rejected in view of the judgment of Hon'ble Supreme Court passed in the case of Ashok Chaturvedi & Ors Vs Shitul H.
Chanchani & Anr reported in (1998) 7 SCC 698.

entities.text:
Ashok Chaturvedi & Ors Vs Shitul H.
Chanchani & Anr reported in (1998) 7 SCC 698
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid submissions of the parties and also considering the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Kahkashan Kausar and Ors Vs State of Bihar and Ors reported in AIR 2022 SC 820, this application is allowed.

entities.text: Kahkashan Kausar and Ors Vs State of Bihar and Ors reported in AIR 2022 SC 820
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the FIR vide Shastri Nagar P.S. Case No. 559 of 2018 dated 29.08.2018 is hereby quashed with regard to the petitioners.
